title: Coupled exponent-walk charge kills L = 50508 at the certified floor
statement: The coupled exponent-walk charge excludes L = 50508 as a CycleMin length at the certified descent floor N0 = 26254995. Transport lemma (EXACT — HUMAN PROOF): on a CycleMin cycle with minimum n >= 400, x_k >= (n e^{-D})^{w_k} with D = 1.05 e / n + 0.7 o / n^{3/2}, from the log-deficit recursion E' <= (3/2)E + 1.05 x^{-3/2} (odd), E' <= E/2 + 1.05 x^{-1/2} (even), amplification exactly w_k / w_{j+1}, odd states >= n with w_{j+1} >= 3/2, even states >= n^2 (cycleMin_even_ge_sq) with w_{j+1} >= 1. Certified comparison: theta(50508) = 7.2649e-6 > (6/5) * WalkDP(50508, 31867; n') = 6.4844e-6 at n' = n e^{-D}, D = 7.4566e-4 — kill margin 1.1204. The DP over (step, odds-used) is exact on the lattice, brute-force-verified, and maximizes over a relaxation of all CycleMin words with (o, e) and u >= 0 (u >= 0 from the defect-free upper envelope). Same trust boundary as Paper A Theorem 4.6.

Consequence: L = 50508 is not a Juggler cycle length at the certified floor; the combined parity + walk contiguous cutoff is fixed by the certified survey (data/research/juggler/cycle_walk_charge/survey.json, summary.json).
